deviations.what: No runtime assertion was added proving the Plans page's full rendered response carries no script element referencing the provider. A test doing exactly that was written under T002, then removed after T010 landed.
deviations.why: T010 adds `demo/templates/base.html`'s own `{% block provider_library %}`, which loads `https://js.stripe.com/v3/pricing-table.js` for every page the demo serves, including the Plans page — correct behaviour under Article XIII's host-project split. That made the removed test fail for a reason that is not a defect: the demo, standing in for a host project, is doing exactly what it is supposed to do. The guarantee SC-002 actually asks for — this package's own templates never emit such a script — is held permanently and exhaustively by T004's static scan instead.
